whyItMatters: A public-read ACL exposes bucket or object contents to the entire internet, including backups, logs, and data exports that were never meant to be public.
actions: Switch the ACL to private and scope access through signed URLs or exact-principal policies.
Enable Block Public Access and audit existing objects for inherited grants.
Re-run a SAST scan after the fix and confirm DPK-SAST-018 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and anonymous reads return access denied.
